actual_futures_leg.contractual_basis: CFFEX educational material defines clean-price basis as cash clean price minus futures price times the conversion factor, and describes buy-cash/sell-futures as long-basis exposure.
actual_futures_leg.direction_for_long_basis_research: buy one exact eligible cash Treasury bond and sell the selected actual T contract only after all no-action gates pass

cash_bond_delivery_route.delivery_link: physical delivery only; the CFFEX delivery rules specify delivery invoice, conversion factor, accrued interest and custody-account procedures
cash_bond_delivery_route.required_custody: an approved CCDC or CSDC Treasury custody account declared through the futures member before delivery-month controls apply
cash_bond_delivery_route.required_instrument: one currently CFFEX-eligible book-entry fixed-coupon Treasury bond from the selected actual T contract's official deliverable list

exchange_traded_etf_substitute.reason: A fund share is not the exact book-entry Treasury bond specified for futures delivery. It therefore cannot be treated as a delivery-basis lock; it retains index-tracking, duration, basket, ETF price-versus-NAV, fund-fee and execution differences.
exchange_traded_etf_substitute.source_fact: Its exchange disclosure says it uses optimized sampling to track an index of Treasury-bond constituents.

candidate_route.name: C12 domestic Treasury cash/futures basis study

basis_and_carry_accounting.boundary: These are frozen research accounting fields, not a realized return, fill or yield assertion.
basis_and_carry_accounting.daily_accounting: Use actual contract settlement marks and separately recorded cash-bond/ETF marks. Daily futures variation and any margin-cash funding must be ledgered; neither may be assumed away.
basis_and_carry_accounting.delivery_invoice_reference: Delivery invoice must follow the dated CFFEX delivery-rule equation using delivery settlement, conversion factor, accrued interest, delivery quantity and contract face amount.
basis_and_carry_accounting.net_basis_concept: NB_i,t = B_i,t - H_i,t, where H is carry/having-cost accounting that must include coupon accrual, funding or repo, cash settlement, futures exchange and broker fees, custody/transfer, margin-cash financing, taxes if applicable, and separately observed execution costs.

required_fields: official conversion factor for that bond and delivery month
cash clean price, accrued interest, coupon schedule and actual settlement convention from a dated permitted source
custody location and transferability consistent with the delivery rule
observed executable cash-bond bid/ask or a predeclared no-fill treatment
cash_bond_screen.selection: Evaluate every officially eligible bond on the same dated information set; do not infer a cheapest-to-deliver bond from maturity alone.

contract_screen.continuous_series_policy: prohibited for accounting, selection, return, roll or target validation
contract_screen.data_source: frozen official CFFEX actual-contract daily CSV rows only
contract_screen.delivery_firewall: No new research action after the last-trade schedule enters the 60-calendar-day screen boundary. Delivery-month use requires a separately verified custody-account approval and exchange-adjusted calendar.
contract_screen.eligible_contract: actual T row with positive settlement, volume and open interest and 60--150 unadjusted calendar days to the second-Friday scheduled last-trade date

paired_execution_policy.allowed_state: no state is executable under the current case evidence
paired_execution_policy.future_test_requirement: A prospective or licensed historical ledger must predeclare same-window paired-leg instructions, timestamp, quote source, partial-fill state, cancellation state, no-fill state, spread/impact treatment and reconciliation of cash, futures and margin cash flows.
prohibited: using daily settlement as an assumed two-leg fill
inventing cash-bond, ETF or futures fills
backfilling a deliverable basket or conversion factor from hindsight

no_action_gates.pass_condition: Complete hash-bound, point-in-time actual T contract history and contract master for every test session; all selected contracts and rolls are actual codes.
Dated official deliverable-bond list, conversion factors, accrued interest/coupon inputs, cash settlement data and custody/transfer state exist for each selected contract.

If ETF is used, it is independently labelled relative-value only and its basket, duration, NAV premium/discount, fees and execution differences are fully ledgered; it cannot receive delivery-basis treatment.
Effective-session cash financing or repo, cash settlement and coupon-reinvestment treatment are source-bound for every ledger session.
Effective-session exchange margin, price-limit, position-limit, delivery-month control and the broker's margin overlay are source-bound for every ledger session.
Exchange fees, broker commissions, cash-bond/ETF costs, custody/transfer charges and taxes are source-bound for every ledger session.
A licensed futures broker confirms the current trading-code route and the applicable custody-account/delivery process for the individual, without recording personal information in this case.
Dated bid/ask, depth or a conservative no-fill convention plus actual permissible broker cost data allow a two-leg execution ledger without invented fills.

no_action_gates.gate: strict annual and rolling-five-year outcome test
no_action_gates.pass_condition: A frozen unit-NAV ledger produces the complete population of full-calendar-year and rolling five-calendar-year windows after costs and independently recomputes the hard 5% standard.

source_scope.actual_contract_source_scope: Six retrospectively captured official CFFEX daily CSV samples, 2016--2026, each carrying actual listed contracts. This is a route observation rather than a full historical replay dataset.
rule_sources: CFFEX dated T contract and Treasury-futures delivery rules

target_requirement.calculation_boundary: Any eventual test must use a unit-NAV ledger with actual contracts, dated cash-bond inputs and recorded costs. A continuous futures return proxy is prohibited.
target_requirement.evidence_status: not measured; no guarantee; no complete actual-contract/cash-bond/cost/fill ledger
target_requirement.hard_standard: each full calendar-year net return >= 5% AND annualized net return for every completed rolling five-calendar-year window >= 5%
